changes: Independently formalized from the manuscript; no upstream Lean proof text reused.

Constructs a common ordered source preparation for the actual chronological partial branches, with fixed original occurrence indices and Euclidean spaces. Each source vector is exactly the original gate vector selected by its local branch label. Allowed source-free residual operations recover every partial branch. A separate consumer constructs the two selective contractions from an actual allowed word, before the arbitrary free input vectors are chosen. Corrected-source density estimates and the physical protocol construction remain separate obligations.
